answer: Minting-cost proof-of-work resists sybils: each new identity must burn real CPU to mine its key, so a seat is a crystal that costs energy to cut, never a free handle. One honest account pays once; a swarm of a thousand fakes pays a thousand separate computations. The ledger is a harbor only for those who paid the toll to dock, so cheap mass registration stalls against compute that no vault of pre-made keys can shortcut.
